articles.title: Ligent Technologies to Debut After $727 Million in Hong Kong IPO
articles.summary: AI computing networks maker Ligent Technologies Inc. is set to debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange on Tuesday after raising HK$5.7 billion ($727 million) in a initial public offering, adding to this year’s stampede of companies capitalizing on the global artificial intelligence buildout.

articles.title: Trump-Xi Summit Puts Global AI Race in Focus
articles.summary: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow breaks down what to expect from the Trump-Xi summit later this week, with AI's role anticipated to be a major part of the agenda for those upcoming talks. Plus, Bloomberg reports Paramount reached a settlement with California and other states suing to block its proposed acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery. And, as data shows more disruption to US data centers, we get to the political debate with Democratic US Representative Suhas Subramanyam from Virginia. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.summary: AI data centers and power grid upgrades are quietly reshaping global copper demand. Morgan Stanley’s Amy Gower breaks down why data centers already punch above their weight, and why US tariff decisions could move copper next. (Source: Bloomberg)
